meta.title: ZeroAPI Runtime — generate a full backend from one JSON spec
meta.description: @ludagg/zeroapi-runtime turns a single declarative spec into a complete, production-ready Hono backend: CRUD, auth, RBAC, relations, webhooks, OpenAPI. Runs on Node, Bun, Deno and Cloudflare Workers. 1075 tests, MIT.

title: The engine behind ZeroAPI:
subtitle: @ludagg/zeroapi-runtime turns a single declarative JSON spec into a complete, production-ready API — CRUD, validation, auth, RBAC, relations, webhooks and OpenAPI docs. The spec is the source of truth, so the contract and the implementation can never drift apart.

highlights.title: Spec-driven CRUD
highlights.body: Full REST for every resource, auto-pluralised, with Zod validation generated from your field definitions and applied on every write.

highlights.title: SQL pushdown
highlights.body: Filtering, search, sorting and pagination compile to a single SQL query in Prisma mode — the database never ships the whole table to Node.

highlights.title: Auth & RBAC
highlights.body: Revocable JWT user system, hashed API keys, OAuth (Google/GitHub), role hierarchy with inheritance and row-level ownership.

highlights.title: Multi-tenant
highlights.body: Declare tenant isolation by column ↔ JWT claim; the runtime scopes reads, forces writes to the tenant, and 404s cross-tenant access.

highlights.title: Durable webhooks
highlights.body: Outbound HMAC-signed events that survive restarts with no double-delivery across replicas, and signing secrets encrypted at rest.

highlights.title: Relations & transactions
highlights.body: manyToOne / oneToMany / manyToMany with nested includes and atomic cascades, plus spec-level ACID operations that roll back on failure.

highlights.title: OpenAPI & SDK
highlights.body: An OpenAPI 3.0.3 document, a Scalar docs UI, a Postman collection and a typed TypeScript client — all generated from the spec.

highlights.title: Production-ready
highlights.body: Helmet headers, rate limiting, a real /ready DB probe, graceful shutdown and deploy configs for Railway, Render, Vercel and Fly.io.

docSubtitle: The full, example-driven guide to @ludagg/zeroapi-runtime — two end-to-end tutorials plus every feature shown as spec in → request → real JSON response: querying, auth, RBAC, multi-tenant, webhooks, transactions, persistence and the createRuntime API.
